domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2c2c9a75bf2d40d91bef5901f5c6dba45a6d134b`
Local-runs: probe — the item-4 pin's red under ablation is shown by no check-run, so `qa-rollup.mjs --self-test` was run once here (on the prior head `390c0a0e`, whose `scripts/qa/**` is byte-identical to this head) on a scratch copy of the file with `onPathOf(url, next[1])` replaced by `next[1]` (the tracked tree untouched): exit 1, three failures — page 2 refused 403 on `/repositories/42/…`, both pages land, asked on the `/repos` path. The green self-tests are CI's (the Fleet Patrols `pull_request` run's "Platform checklist gate sweep" executes `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, which runs both qa self-tests; green on this head).
Scope: .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the seat grammar and the ceilings the lane file and the seat word move), scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs, scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs (the tools qa.md and checklist-test §5–§6 name), docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md (prose describing qa-rollup's page-2 behaviour)

### ① Derived judgments

- Net diff against `main` (merge-base `cba7d8ae`, three commits, this head the third): 10 files, +118/−42. Four governed paths, all under `.claude/**`; the other six are `scripts/pm/**`, `scripts/qa/**` and `docs/qa/**`. The third commit (`2c2c9a75`) changes one line of `lanes/qa.md` and nothing else; every other file is byte-identical to the previously reviewed head `390c0a0e`. `main` has moved 13 commits since the merge-base and none of them touches a file in this diff; `git merge-tree` against current `origin/main` is clean.
- Face and tier read off the paths: `record-recognisers --template --paths` over the ten files answers the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, with the four `.claude/**` files as `hits`. `check-governed-merges` tiers the `.claude/**` row Tier S in objectstack alone (`GOVERNED_SURFACES`, `tierRepos: ['objectstack']`), and the tier is ALL-not-ANY: every governed path here lies under that one row, so the PR is Tier S and lands on the owning seat's in-seat `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` + `**VERDICT: PASS**` on the current head plus every check green (`contract-review.md` 落地前检 ①, the Tier S verdict block at `check-governed-merges.mjs`). The card's ruling text said "Tier H"; that was triage's expectation, and the register decides, not the prose.
- **Text owed, item 1 (one owner).** `lanes/skills.md` 「QA 管理循环执行归本席」 → 「QA 循环执行归 `qa#1` 席(`qa.md`),本席只管其技能文本」; checklist-test §6 「定时任务由派发的 PM 会话建」 → 「归 QA 席 `qa#1`(pm-dispatch `lanes/qa.md`);其定时任务由维护者为该席建」. Both name `qa#1`; the skills seat keeps the text. Fixed as ruled.
- **Item 2 (waves vs routines).** `lanes/skills.md` keeps 「QA 波次由维护者手动触发,⛔ 不自启」 and adds 「checklist-test §6 两条例行按期由 `qa#1` 跑,不是波次」. `lanes/qa.md` 边界 says the same from the other side (波次仍由维护者手动触发;本席只跑 §6 两条例行). Fixed as ruled.
- **Item 3 (§5 close line).** A 「关闭」 paragraph before the Supersede protocol: close-out complete ⇒ the QA seat closes the record `completed` that round with a one-line pointer to the close-out comment; residuals stay on their own cards; retests are owed through `retest-owed.mjs`; ⛔ not held open for fixes. Every element the card and the order named is present; the paragraph is two text lines plus its break, +3.
- **Item 4 (page 2).** Premise correction holds: on `main`, `retest-owed.mjs` already carried `onPathOf` and `listAll` already hopped through it (line 655 on `main`), so only `qa-rollup.mjs` followed the numeric link. The fix moves `onPathOf` into `qa-rollup.mjs` (which `retest-owed.mjs` already imported from), exports `fetchRunRecords` with a `fetchImpl` seam defaulting to `fetch`, and hops with `onPathOf(url, next[1])`. The pin: a new battery 「a listing stays on the repository path」 (4 assertions, roster entry added, `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 11 → 12) feeds a fake fetch whose page 1 carries GitHub's real `Link` shape naming `/repositories/42/…` and answers that path 403 — no network. Under my ablation the battery reds in three of its four assertions, matching the report. `retest-owed.mjs`'s own battery of the same name (2 checks) exercises the moved helper directly; its `listAll` wiring is byte-identical to `main`. Both scripts therefore share one pinned spelling.
- **`lanes/qa.md` scope.** Present: both §6 routines (the four weekly records named selector by selector; `smoke:npm-VERSION` after each release), `retest-owed.mjs` first each round with its ids scoping `owed:weekly`, §5 close-out, record close `completed`, Supersede per §5, `qa-rollup.mjs` at round end, a spend line. ⛔ lines: no `os-dev`, no product code, no PR; defect cards to triage first-touch without grading or queueing; security only via `../security-findings.md` (the file exists); waves manual; skill text with `domain:skills` and RUNNER text with `domain:devx`; GitHub writes only through the checklist-test §4 write gate. Powers claimed: none beyond the ruling — the seat is declared with no `domain:*` label and no `pm:queue` (the `security.md` shape), it does not build or re-time its own routine, it does not judge releases. No new gate, label or protocol key appears anywhere in the diff.
- **Seat grammar (pin move).** `qa` joins `SEAT_BARE_LANES` (mailbox-open) and `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (check-half-states), the two lists `fleet-roster`'s self-test holds equal (`coordinator` aside) — the same two edits `review` took. Effect: `qa#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION` reads as a signature in `post-stamped`/`issue-create` (both import `SEAT_SIGNATURE_SHAPE`/`signatureRefusal` from check-half-states), `mailbox-open --seat qa#N` opens a mailbox, and a `domain:qa` lane is refused as the slug collision it would be. No rule in check-half-states keys off a lane word (grep for `lane === '…'` finds none), and `record-recognisers` sorts a signed lane into `triage` / `review` / `lane`, where `qa` falls on the lane side like `security`. So the widening admits the seat's signature and nothing else; `N` is unbounded exactly as for `security#N`/`review#N`.
- **Ratchet raise.** The docblock's raise rule: the raising PR quotes the ruling-of-record id and the measured delta in its body and moves the row by at most that delta. The PR body and the map comment quote 6715420603 (maintainer letter A, 「同意 新设 qa#1」), whose workload orders the three text fixes, two of which land in checklist-test. Measured: checklist-test 279 lines, row 276 → 279, delta +3 = row move. `lanes/qa.md` 29 lines on this head (the one-line change is a rewrite in place, 0 lines), new row 29 with headroom 0 and a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row 0 (it has no table), as every lane charter; `laneRosterVerdict` requires both. No other row moves (the ratchet diff is exactly those three lines). `skills.md` 32/33 and `project-forms.md` 59/59 are unchanged in count. `check:pm-skill-ratchet` runs in "Lint · repo & tooling gates", green on `390c0a0e`; on this head that lane is still running at read time and the only changed file is not one it measures differently (29/29).
- **RUNNER.md −10/+4.** Removed: the (1)/(2) numbering, the measured 403 at `bfc1539fe0` with 130 records, the proxy's refusal text, the #24579 §6 reference, and the workaround ("run where the proxy is not in the path, or read the pages by number"). Kept: the `classifySelector` blind spot and the ⛔ that a 403 there says nothing about repository access, now stated against the fixed behaviour. The workaround is obsolete once the tool does it; the measurement moves to qa-rollup's header ("measured: 403") and git history. Nothing still needed was dropped. `docs/qa` is `domain:devx` text by the 域车道 table, so this devx seat's PR is in lane for it.
- **pm-dispatch SKILL.md lane table.** It lists `security` · `review` as a row 「车道,无 `domain:*` 标签」 and does not list `triage` or `director`. The row measures 315 bytes against the 341-byte `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin; naming `qa` with a pointer costs about 45, so the arithmetic in the report is right. The table's own update rule (line 168) binds `domain:*` additions only, and the seat word is read from `project-forms.md`, where `qa` now is. Not a gap on this head; see ④.
- **Out of scope held.** No `.github/**` path in the diff. No `qa-run` record is closed by the PR (only `Fixes #31305`, as ruled). No routine or trigger is created by anything in the tree; the PR body asks the maintainer to build the weekly routine after merge, as the ruling says. The 15 closes and #29560 were triage's; the report's real read-only run saw 0 open `qa-run`.
- **Report fields against GitHub.** Branch, head, PR number, labels (`skip-changeset`, no assignee, draft) and the `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` lines match. Ruling 6501246005 (the two routines) is on #27377, devx#1's record of the maintainer's words that ordered §6; §6 keeps citing it.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `scripts/pm/**`, `scripts/qa/**`, `docs/**` and `.claude/**` ship in no package. Check Changeset was `success` on `390c0a0e`; the third commit adds no package path. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold — no published spec or metadata surface moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Should-fix from the review of `390c0a0e`, resolved at this head.** `lanes/qa.md` 边界 read 「技能与 RUNNER 文本归 `domain:skills`」, misnaming a lane: `RUNNER.md` lives under `docs/qa`, which the pm-dispatch SKILL.md 域车道 table anchors to `domain:devx`, and the card ruled only that *skill* text stays with `domain:skills`. Commit `2c2c9a75` rewrites the line to 「技能文本归 `domain:skills`、RUNNER 归 `domain:devx`;本席见文本问题以 `finding` 报,⛔ 不自改」 — the wording the record asked for, 0 lines, the file still 29/29. Read on the head; nothing else moved.
- Card lane `domain:skills`, executed by `domain:devx#3` on the maintainer's 「这个卡你让他直接派发处理」, recorded in the claim (6715841948) with the file surface declared; the label stayed `domain:skills`. In-seat review by the dispatching seat is the standing path (`contract-review.md` 谁跑 = 派发席).
- Branch `claude/project-thread-6n4eey` (a card thread, not `claude/issue-N-slug`): the measured platform exception named in the claim. `Implemented-by` below names it.
- Tier: the ruling's text said Tier H; the register answers S. No maintainer merge is owed, only the routine after landing. Informational.
- Deviation, informational: the report's third out-of-scope note (harness context asking for assignee/reviewer and PR subscription vs the order's no-assignee / no-MCP-write rule) — the order was followed; the PR has no assignee.
- Tests: pin present and ablated (dev's run, re-shown by my probe); gates 57/57 per the report on `390c0a0e`, and the third commit touches no file a gate measures beyond the ratchet, which the dev reports exit 0 at 29/29 and `wc -l` confirms.
- Line budget 160 changed lines, under 3000.

### ④ Design judgment

- `lanes/qa.md` against the ruling, the three model charters and checklist-test §4–§6 on this head: holds, including the corrected lane pointer. The text agrees with the code it cites: the runner is dispatched by the session that starts the round (§2), its security repro goes privately to that session (Guardrails), the write gate is §4, `Routine 席` is the defined form (SKILL.md 席位两形; `seat-post-protocol.md`: Routine seats are created by the maintainer in the Routines UI), and 「本席不自建」 is the charter-defined exception `project-forms.md` allows (总监与宪章定的按需席不建).
- `lanes/skills.md` and checklist-test §5/§6: the three texts and `qa.md` now say one thing — one owner, waves manual, routines scheduled, close on close-out. §5's 「QA 席」 and §6's `qa#1` are the same seat; no reader resolves a lane from §5's wording.
- `project-forms.md`: `qa` as a seat word resolves to an existing `lanes/qa.md`. Observation, not this PR's: neither seat-word list names `security`.
- `mailbox-open.mjs` / `check-half-states.mjs`: the two lists move together, prose counts (six → seven, four → five) follow, self-test pins updated; `fleet-roster`'s equality pin and `check:pm-record-recognisers` would have reddened a one-sided move and were green on `390c0a0e`, which these files share byte for byte. Same shape as the `review` landing.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: a legitimate raise under the file's own rule (ruling id + measured delta, row moved by exactly the delta), plus the census-required new rows.
- `qa-rollup.mjs`: `onPathOf` keeps the current URL's path and takes the next link's whole query, so both the `after=` cursor and `page=2` ride; the seam defaults to global `fetch`, so the CLI path is unchanged. The self-test battery is offline and reds under ablation. **Nit**: `retest-owed.mjs`'s battery pins the helper, not `listAll`'s use of it through a fake client; the wiring is unchanged `main` code, so nothing is owed on this head.
- `RUNNER.md`: the retained ⛔ keeps the one reader-facing lesson; the removed workaround would now mislead. Holds.
- pm-dispatch SKILL.md lane table: **nit**, no fix owed. The table anchors files to lanes; `qa`, like `triage` and `director`, has no file surface, and the row-width pin and the SKILL.md line ceiling (319) both bind. If the `security` · `review` row is ever compressed, naming `qa` there would be a reasonable 0-line follow-up.

Check-runs on `2c2c9a75`, read at 2026-11-08T02:38Z: 42 runs so far, 12 `success`, 16 `skipped` (opt-in and matrix placeholders), 0 `failure`, 14 `in_progress` (the `Lint · …` and `Type Check · …` lanes, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Live half-state sweep`). Green already: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Platform checklist gate sweep` (both qa self-tests), `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Live required-set sweep`, `Release section-coverage sweep`, `Test UI`. On the previous head `390c0a0e`, whose tree differs from this one by the single `qa.md` line, every completed run was green (29 success, 20 skipped, 0 failure). The seat waits for the in-flight runs to complete green before landing; this PASS stands on the head's content regardless of their outcome.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-6n4eey`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT** · head `2c2c9a75bf2d40d91bef5901f5c6dba45a6d134b` · card #31305 · report 6716149830 · contract review 6716287586 (PASS, rules face, CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, on this head).

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #31305`. 10 files, +118/-42, all inside the claim's surface:
  - `lanes/qa.md` (new) and `lanes/skills.md`
  - `project-forms.md`, checklist-test SKILL.md and `docs/qa/.../RUNNER.md`
  - `scripts/pm/{check-half-states,check-skill-line-ratchet,mailbox-open}.mjs`
  - `scripts/qa/{qa-rollup,retest-owed}.mjs`
- **GOVERNED, Tier S.** `check-governed-merges` puts every governed path under `.claude/**`, a Tier S row, so this in-seat CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS on the current head is the landing record. The card's "Tier H" was an expectation, not the register's answer.
- **Ruling (option A, 6715420603), read in the diff:**
  - `lanes/qa.md` covers both §6 routines, close-out, close, supersede and the weekly `retest-owed`, with every ⛔ line.
  - Text owed items 1–3 are fixed as ruled.
  - Item 4: `onPathOf` is shared through `qa-rollup`, and a no-network battery with a fake `Link` header pins it. The reviewer re-ran the ablation (3 reds).
  - `qa` joins `SEAT_BARE_LANES` and `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` the same way `review` did. That is a pin move, and it admits only the seat's signature.
  - The ratchet raise 276 → 279 on checklist-test is measured (+3) and cites the ruling.
- **Should-fix resolved at this head.** The `lanes/qa.md` boundary line now gives RUNNER text to `domain:devx` and skill text to `domain:skills` (commit `2c2c9a75`, one line, still 29/29 lines).
- **Out of scope held:** no routine or trigger started, no `qa-run` records closed, no `.github/**`.
- **Gates:** 57/57 derived exit 0. On the prior head every completed check was green. Automerge waits for this head's required check-runs.
- **After landing:** the maintainer starts the `qa#1` routine (its first act is `retest-owed.mjs`, then the first `owed:weekly` record). Triage closes the 15 `qa-run` records and #29560.
- **Landing:** under 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z), 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」 (2026-11-07T16:59Z) and 「这个卡你让他直接派发处理」 (2026-11-08T01:49Z): `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` now.
